description: This file defines React components and hooks for building and managing forms using react-hook-form, including context management for form fields, labels, descriptions, and validation messages.

methods.name: useFormField
methods.description: Custom hook to access form field state, errors, and related IDs within form components.

methods.name: Form
methods.description: Higher-order component for wrapping form elements, providing context via react-hook-form's FormProvider.

methods.name: FormItem
methods.description: Component that provides a unique ID context for form items, wrapping input controls, labels, descriptions, and messages.

methods.name: FormLabel
methods.description: Component rendering a label for a form control, indicating validation errors.

methods.name: FormControl
methods.description: Component for rendering the form control element with appropriate ARIA attributes.

methods.name: FormDescription
methods.description: Component to display auxiliary descriptions for a form item.

methods.name: FormMessage
methods.description: Component for rendering validation error messages associated with a form field.
